verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community comment confirming a built-in Copilot integration in Outlook, and the same user found it slower than copy-pasting into another client. Nothing documents what tasks can be handed to it. Graph API delegation of mailbox send rights (outlook-docs-9) is human delegation, not an AI assistant, and the external LLM/MCP search in outlook-comm-13 is a user-side workaround; neither is credited. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the built-in assistant, evidence of which tasks can be delegated (drafting, summarizing, triage, scheduling), agentic action-taking, and positive hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: They sometimes miss the Copilot integration, but say copy-pasting into Thunderbird is still faster than using Copilot in Outlook.
